title: Block Out Level 22 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 22 is a single giant boss-room puzzle around a purple `17` panel. Dismantle the checker roof first, let the huge boss panel start falling second, and clean up the late blue and pink pieces only after the lid is gone.

landmarks: Block Out Level 22 is a single giant boss-room puzzle around a purple `17` panel.
Dismantle the checker roof first, let the huge boss panel start falling second, and clean up the late blue and pink pieces only after the lid is gone.
The board mixes Purple, Black, White and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The roof matters more than the boss at the start.
The right red strip is part of the roof cleanup, not an early finisher.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Strip the top checker roof from left to right so the upper blockers stop sealing the chamber.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Move the right red strip only after the surrounding black blocks have shifted.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the `17` panel parked while the side counters and roof continue shrinking.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the roof is thin enough, start draining the `17` boss panel.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the newly opened upper lane to bring out the late blue and pink pieces.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Flatten the remaining cyan columns after the boss value is much lower.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish the room once the boss panel has fully collapsed.

failurePoints: Working the `17` panel before the roof has opened.
Leaving the right red strip buried in the roof when the black blocks still need to move.
